patterns.note: The page is structured with distinct, full-width color-blocked sections, often featuring asymmetrical internal layouts for content distribution.
A vibrant, almost primary-color palette is used for large background blocks, creating strong visual segmentation, contrasted with a dark brown footer and white or dark text.

The hero image/video exhibits a subtle parallax effect, the main navigation sticks to the top, content sections reveal with a fade-up/slide-up animation, and a large, fixed background text element reveals as content scrolls over it.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for impact, combined with a more restrained, legible sans-serif for body text, maintaining a clear visual hierarchy.
Each major content area is defined by a full-bleed, solid color block, creating a modular and visually distinct 'block-stacking' feel throughout the page.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, transparent brand logo overlaying a background video or image that exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the scroll to create depth.
The main navigation is composed of distinct, full-width color blocks that initially scroll with the page but then become sticky at the top of the viewport, maintaining accessibility.
Content sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation, typically a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp (mostly rectangular blocks with minimal rounding)
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous vertical spacing between major sections, balanced internal padding)

standout: The bold and playful use of full-bleed, contrasting color blocks for section backgrounds, combined with the large, fixed background brand name in the footer, creates a distinctive, almost architectural feel. This modular, color-driven approach to layout is highly memorable.
